admin.only_note: Only an owner or an admin manages this page.
admin.people_profiles_hint: A member sees only the profiles chosen here: their chats, agents and tasks.
admin.people_own_password_note: This device stays signed in; your other devices are signed out.
admin.lockouts_none_body: An address locks after repeated failed sign-ins and unlocks itself when the time is up.
admin.links_subtitle: Each person's Telegram and WhatsApp accounts. A message from one acts as that person, in the profiles they may enter.
admin.links_none: Nobody has linked a messaging account.
admin.links_remove_body: Its next message gets none of Core Hub's tools. The agent still answers it.
admin.profiles_note: Separate profiles: their agents, models and conversations do not see each other.
admin.profiles_rename_hint: Any name, in any language. The id {slug} does not change, so chats, channels and schedules keep working.
admin.profiles_archive_body: The profile is folded away here and its memberships end. Its Hermes profile and its conversations ({sessions}) stay and are not erased.
admin.profiles_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes — it appears in links.
admin.profiles_slug_bad: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting and ending with one
admin.profiles_origin_blank_what: A fresh Hermes profile with its default settings and bundled skills.
admin.profiles_clone_what: Copies the config, the personality (SOUL.md) and the skills — not memory, chats or channels.
admin.profiles_export_what: Hermes writes this profile as its own archive (.tar.gz): its personality (SOUL.md), memory, skills, settings and chats. The file can be imported here, or with hermes profile import.
admin.profiles_export_secrets: Keys stay behind: credential files (.env, auth.json) are left out, and any provider key stored in this hub is blanked wherever it appears. Only you can download the archive, for 24 hours.
admin.profiles_export_keys_warning: The file will contain this profile's providers with their API keys in the clear — its own and the shared ones it uses. Anyone who has the file can use those keys. Importing it makes them the new profile's own.
admin.profiles_export_providers_carried: Providers in the file, keys included: {count}
admin.profiles_import_what: Choose a Hermes profile archive (.tar.gz) — one exported here or with hermes profile export. Hermes makes a new profile from it under the slug below.
admin.profiles_import_confirm_body: Hermes makes the profile {slug} from the file. The upload and the import can take a minute.
admin.profiles_import_too_large: The archive is larger than the hub accepts for an upload (50 MB).
admin.profiles_import_unreadable: That file could not be read on this phone.
admin.profiles_import_replace_default: Replace the default profile with this one
admin.profiles_import_replace_default_hint: For moving here from another program: the archive becomes the default profile, and the current default is kept as a backup you can switch back to.
admin.profiles_import_replace_name_hint: The default profile takes this name.
admin.profiles_import_replace_confirm_body: Your current default profile will be replaced by this archive, and the archive becomes the default. The current one is kept whole as a new profile named default-backup (or the next free name): its memory, skills, Hermes conversations, schedules and channels go with it, and its channels keep answering from there. A conversation running right now stops. Shared providers and their keys stay with the default. If anything fails, nothing changes.
admin.profiles_import_replace_done: Your previous default is kept as “{backup}”; you can delete it any time.
admin.profiles_import_replace_unsupported: This hub is older than this option: the archive was imported as a new profile, {name}, and the default is unchanged.
admin.push_intro: Web Push (browsers and the desktop app) works with nothing to set up. Android (FCM) and iPhone (APNs) need the owner's credentials.
admin.push_fcm_intro: Firebase Console → Project settings → Service accounts → Generate new private key. Choose the JSON file it downloads.
admin.push_apns_intro: Apple Developer → Certificates, IDs & Profiles → Keys: a key with Apple Push Notifications service (APNs).
admin.push_secret_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
admin.push_secret_kept: A key is stored. Leave this empty to keep it.
admin.push_forget_body: Its credentials are deleted from this hub. Phones stop getting notifications through it until it is set up again.
admin.push_fcm_not_json: That file is not JSON. Choose the service-account key Firebase downloaded.
admin.push_fcm_google_services: That is google-services.json, the Android app's own file. The hub needs a service-account key: Firebase Console → Project settings → Service accounts → Generate new private key.
admin.push_fcm_not_service_account: That JSON is not a service-account key. Generate one under Firebase Console → Project settings → Service accounts.
admin.push_fcm_missing: That service account is missing type, project_id, client_email or private_key. Download a new key from Firebase.
admin.push_apns_ok: Key read. Its Key ID was taken from the file name.
admin.push_apns_ok_no_id: Key read. Type its Key ID below.
admin.push_apns_not_a_key: That is not a .p8 key: it should start with -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----.
admin.push_apns_not_p8: That is not the .p8 file. Apple lets you download it once, as AuthKey_<Key ID>.p8.
admin.push_file_unreadable: That file could not be read on this phone.
admin.push_env_title: Or set it with environment variables
admin.push_env_body: Variables set on the hub win over what is saved here (docs/DEPLOY.md):
admin.push_saved_incomplete: Saved, but not complete yet: open it again to fill in what is left.
admin.push_valid_fcm: Saved. The service account looks valid; the first notification proves it with Google.
admin.push_valid_apns: Saved. The key looks valid (it signed a test token); the first notification proves it with Apple.
admin.pairing_request: {name} wants to message the agent on {platform}
admin.pairing_hint: Approve or deny them here, or under Approvals on the agent's channels page.
